articles.title: BBC’s Antisemitism Crisis Represents an Unprecedented Chapter for the World’s Most Trusted News Organization
articles.summary: It is a dark day for the BBC. On Thursday, government adviser Lord John Mann announced he is launching an investigation into alleged antisemitism at the broadcaster. It is an unprecedented chapter for the corporation, long held up as one of the most venerable and reliable media institutions in the…
body: Later, the broadcaster steadfastly refused to reprimand Gary Lineker, one of its most high-profile sports anchors, as he repeatedly breached its much-touted social media guidelines, which were instituted precisely because of Lineker’s increasingly political Twitter activity. Under the guidelines, high-profile presenters hosting flagship programs are expected to be impartial while the show is on air and for a two-week window before and after. At the time, he called the guidelines “very sensible.”

It was only when last year Lineker reposted an Instagram story about “Zionists” alongside a rat emoji that the BBC finally cut him loose. Even then, rather than a punitive measure, his exit was presented to the public as a mutually agreed decision for the host to leave after the final “Match of the Day” episode aired the following week. The BBC’s press release went on to call him a “defining voice in football coverage” and “thank him for the contribution he has made.”

articles.title: Record Store Day Co-Founder on How Black Friday Evolved Into a Major Holiday for Vinyl Hounds, and What Will Fly Off the Shelves This Year
articles.summary: In April of this year, the 19th installment of Record Store Day was the event’s most successful ever, but Nov. 27 brings another opportunity for music junkies to get their vinyl on: Record Store Day Black Friday. While the O.G.
body: While the O.G. Record Store Day was conceived as a general celebration of independent record stores, and features limited-edition, in-store only releases, the Black Friday edition exists for a different reason: to give those indie stores a slice of the “biggest shopping day of the year” pie. That’s also why the vinyl releases you’ll find making their debuts on Black Friday are more likely to remain there for the rest of the holiday season, and why many stores will make them available on their websites starting on Saturday the 28th.

The concept of hyping local independent record stores as a must for holiday shopping may sound rather obvious, but RSD co-founder Michael Kurtz says that, at first, he was opposed to the idea, which his wife came up with.

articles.title: Huw Edwards gives first interviews since child abuse image conviction
articles.summary: The disgraced ex-BBC News presenter will appear in a TV documentary, newspaper interview and podcast.
body: Disgraced former BBC News presenter Huw Edwards has given his first interviews since being convicted in 2024 for making indecent images of children.
Edwards is seen saying he believes "silence is toxic" in a clip of a podcast released by the Observer newspaper, and he has also been interviewed for a Channel 4 documentary.
Edwards, formerly the BBC's most senior news presenter, pleaded guilty in July 2024 to three counts of making indecent images of children and was given a suspended six-month prison sentence.

A government minister, Anna Turley, told LBC, external she was "deeply uncomfortable" with the interviews, and that "for too long, so many of these people in the public eye have been able to have a sort of free pass".

articles.title: Protesters disrupt Paul Smith's book talk
articles.summary: The fashion firm says it is committed to animal welfare following protests at a book tour event.
body: Fashion firm Paul Smith has told the BBC it is committed to animal welfare after protesters disrupted a talk by the brand's founder in his home city.
Two supporters of People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA) interrupted the event hosted by Sir Paul Smith at Nottingham's Broadway Cinema on Wednesday.
The protest follows investigations by PETA into alleged animal cruelty at mohair production facilities in South Africa and Lesotho, including one it said had links to a Paul Smith supplier.
The company said it upholds the highest standards of animal welfare across its supply chain.

articles.title: ‘Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping’ Devouring $85M Over Thanksgiving Weekend as ‘Focker-in-Law,’ ‘Hexed’ Launch
articles.summary: Lionsgate's sixth film in its dystopian franchise looks to win its sophomore frame after notching franchise records with its debut Monday and Tuesday.
body: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping is claiming the head of the table at the Thanksgiving weekend box office as Focker-in-Law and Hexed enter the arena.

After opening to the fifth-biggest launch in Lionsgate history last weekend with $119 million domestically and $225 million worldwide, The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping has continued its momentum. The $150 million-budgeted film, which earned an A- CinemaScore, grossed $15.98 million domestically on Tuesday to notch the franchise’s biggest first Tuesday, narrowly topping the $15.96 million for 2013’s Catching Fire. Sunrise’ s Monday sum of $12.8 million also bested the series’ previous top opening Monday of $12.3 million for Catching Fire.

The East Coast has been impacted by a major storm stretching from the Midwest to the Eastern seaboard, leading the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York to be moved to Saturday for the first postponement in its 100-year history. The inclement weather could slow down moviegoing throughout the weekend, including on Black Friday, which tends to be the biggest day for the box office over the Thanksgiving frame.

articles.title: Tributes for Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor after his death aged 65
articles.summary: Simon Le Bon and his other bandmates say Taylor "brought an indelible fire and swagger to our music".
body: Simon Le Bon, Sir Rod Stewart and Gary Kemp are among the pop stars who have paid tribute to Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor following his death at the age of 65.
Taylor co-wrote some of the group's biggest hits including Save A Prayer, Rio and Girls On Film.

Taylor's wife Tracey called him "the rock of our family", adding: "We will miss him every single day." He died after "a long and courageous battle with prostate cancer", Duran Duran said in a statement on Wednesday.
He died "peacefully at home, surrounded by his family, on Monday 23rd November", a statement said.

articles.title: Government's antisemitism adviser launches investigation into BBC
articles.summary: Lord Mann says he has launched the investigation after "growing discomfort among Jewish BBC staff".
body: The government's antisemitism adviser has launched an investigation into the BBC over allegations of a "hostile work environment" for Jews.
Lord Mann told BBC Radio 4's Today programme he had decided to open the investigation "because there seems to be a growing feeling of discomfort among Jewish staff".

He said: "If that's true, and that's what I'm going to attempt to find out, and if that is widespread, then that's a really serious problem that has to be addressed. And I don't hear and see that being addressed, and at a senior level."
The BBC said it takes "any and all allegations of discrimination extremely seriously – there is no place for it at the BBC".

articles.title: BBC Under Investigation for Antisemitism Amid “Growing Feeling of Discomfort Among Jewish Staff”
articles.summary: Government adviser John Mann has opened his own investigation into the broadcaster, as a rep for says: "We take any and all allegations of discrimination extremely seriously."
body: The BBC is under investigation over allegations of “a hostile work environment” for Jewish employees.

Lord John Mann, the government’s antisemitism adviser, told the broadcaster’s Today program on Thursday that he’s opening an investigation “because there seems to be a growing feeling of discomfort among Jewish staff,” adding: “Some of the things that I’m being told have been quite disturbing sometimes, how little the senior managers of the BBC seem to get it, and so I’m opening this up.”
Concluded the statement: “We are determined to ensure the BBC is a place where everyone can be themselves and feel accepted.”

Mann won’t be probing any department or program in particular, but said an “underlying atmosphere” hostile to Jewish members of staff. “The personal validations that I hear from former and current BBC Jewish employees and contractors is that, fundamentally, there is an institutional culture that demands that Jewish people must be expected to justify their existence, their identity, how they define their Jewishness,” he said.

articles.title: ‘Dark’ Creators Revisit Eerie German Forests in First ‘Sonnental’ Teaser
articles.summary: Lisa Vicari stars as a profiler investigating a gruesome murder in her old hometown, inspired by 'Struwwelpeter,' a real and really sinister German children's book.
body: Jantje Friese and Baran bo Odar, creators of Netflix’ cult hit series Dark, are going back into those eerie German woods.
HBO Max has released the first teaser trailer for the pair’s new mystery thriller, Sonnental, and it looks as Grimm as they come. Check it out the below.

The six-part series stars Lisa Vicari as Anja Vogler, a profiler sent in to investigate a gruesome murder in her old hometown. As more bodies pile up, Vogler begins to see a connection between the killings and motifs from Struwwelpeter, a sinister (and very real) German children’s book meant to scare kids straight with nasty stories of what can happen if they misbehave.

Peter Kurth (Babylon Berlin) co-stars as investigator Norbert Troschitz. The regular cast includes Jan Friedrichsen as Anja’s son Max, Iris Böhm as Anja’s mother Kerstin, Merlin Rose, Maria Simon, Mišel Matičević and Stipe Erceg.
